title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in the Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to Be Known as the Tanauan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in the Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to Be Known as the Tanauan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Thị trấn Tanauan, Tỉnh Leyte được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Tanauan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในเทศบาล Tanauan, จังหวัด Leyte ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Tanauan
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Kotamadya Tanauan, Provinsi Leyte dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Tanauan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Perbandaran Tanauan, Wilayah Leyte dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Tanauan

text.en: There shall be established a high school in the Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to be known as the Tanauan National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
